name: desafio-automacao-mobile
description: Projeto de automação mobile com WebdriverIO e Appium para o desafio de testes mobile.

scripts.test:report: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path './reports/allure-report') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force './reports/allure-report' }; if (Test-Path './reports/allure-results') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force './reports/allure-results' }; npx.cmd wdio run ./wdio.conf.js; npx.cmd allure generate ./reports/allure-results --clean -o ./reports/allure-report; $job = Start-Process npx.cmd -ArgumentList 'http-server ./reports/allure-report -p 8000 -c-1 --silent' -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Start-Process 'http://localhost:8000'; Write-Host 'Relatorio HTML gerado com sucesso. Acesse: http://localhost:8000'"
